Note reading, row preparation, workbook setup and final CSV verification are outside the timer. The template calculates balance and discrepancy where the baseline and unit permit.

pantryRelay.protocol: Use a separate incognito workspace offline after a service-worker reload. Reset and select the mode before each timer. Time note entry, real extraction, human review or fallback as available, then copy the handoff and observe Copied. The measured elapsed time includes UI automation and review pauses between actions.
